characters.name: thor
characters.description: Thor — the singer/narrator. Adult man, contemplative gaze, present and grounded. Aesthetic: wintry/poetic/noir palette (cool silvers, deep blues, candlelight warmth). Mood: introspective, listening to bells in the frozen night.

shots.description: Thor faces camera, expression contemplative, lit warmly against a near-black backdrop. He sings the line softly: "Hear the silver bells in the frozen air, how they tinkle and tinkle through the night." Mouth motion follows the audio precisely; eyes hold steady, as if listening to bells only he can hear.
